messages.subject: clustering and attrition weights in Lavaan
parts:
Hello all!

I am beginner to use lavaan and latent growth curve models in R.

I am writing post requesting information using Lavaan for LGCM for a data that include clusters and contain attrition weights.  I am unsure how to incorporate the attrition weight and the same time account for cluster (i am not using multilevel approach as level 2 is not of interest) in the growth model, in the growth function in lavaan package 

Doubts: 

  1. The Lavaan package description mentions that sampling.weights argument is currently available only for the un-clustered data. So how should you account for attrition weights and cluster at the same time in growth function of lavaan package?
  2. Can Lavaan.survey package be used here?

thanks in advance!
regards,
Sree

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: clustering and attrition weights in Lavaan
parts:
On 11/10/23 15:29, Sreemanjari Kandhasamy wrote:
> 1. The Lavaan package description mentions that sampling.weights
> argument is currently available only for the un-clustered data.

> how should you account for attrition weights and cluster at the same
> time in growth function of lavaan package?

If you use the 'clustered' (but not the multilevel) approach, then the
point estimates ignore the clustering anyway. So you can use the
sampling.weights to get point estimates.

To get standard errors, things are a bit tricky. Usually I would say:
use the bootstrap, but you need to take the clustering into account. One
approach is the 'resample' the clusters, and keep the units within a
cluster together.

> 2. Can Lavaan.survey package be used here?

I believe so. The svydesign() function from the survey package accepts
weights. So this should work.

(BTW, the lavaan.survey package is no longer maintained, but you can get
it from the CRAN archive).

Yves.
